# `cume_dist`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Computes the position of a value relative to all values in the partition.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
cume_dist()
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `window_funcs` |
| Kind | window (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- cume_dist, example 1
> SELECT a, b, cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b) FROM VALUES ('A1', 2), ('A1', 1), ('A2', 3), ('A1', 1) tab(a, b);
A1 | 1 | 0.6666666666666666
A1 | 1 | 0.6666666666666666
A1 | 2 | 1.0
A2 | 3 | 1.0
```

## Version history
